response.justification: Broad, long-tenured full-stack engineer with genuinely relevant highlights: high-throughput microservices at Sociomantic/dunnhumby (millions of HTTP requests/sec, async I/O, fibers, caching), current Staff-level title, and hands-on work on MCP code generators and agentic developer tooling at re:cinq — which maps directly to the AI-native mindset requirement. The main mismatch is the technical stack and level signal: Python is absent from the skills list and every role, while the JD requires strong Python; TypeScript depth is solid, so the language gap is the inverse of what the role wants. Evidence of staff-level scope (technical strategy, cross-functional stakeholder management, formal on-call/incident ownership, agile ceremony leadership) is thin — the resume is framed around craft, testing and breadth rather than driving decisions at scale. Worth a screening call to probe Python proficiency, distributed-systems ownership depth, and staff-scope influence, but not an obvious yes on paper.
strengths: Real high-throughput distributed systems experience (millions of req/sec, low-latency services)
Current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP/agentic tooling work
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, teaching and open-source ownership
concerns: No evidence of Python anywhere in skills or roles, despite it being a must-have
Limited demonstrated staff-level scope: technical strategy, stakeholder management, cross-functional influence
No mention of production on-call, monitoring ownership, or incident response
